parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 1000.

Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

*   If **NextToken** is empty, no next page exists.
*   If a value of **NextToken** is returned, the value indicates the token that is used for the next query.

parameters.name: ServerIds
parameters.description:
The server IDs.

You can specify at most 200 servers in each call.

parameters.name: ServerIps
parameters.description:
The server IP addresses.

You can specify at most 200 servers in each call.

parameters.name: Skip
parameters.description: The number of entries to be skipped in the call.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gwlb list-server-group-servers --server-group-id sgp-atstuj3rtoptyui0000 --server-ids i-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --server-ips 192.168.xxx.xxx --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --max-results 20 --skip 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gwlb ListServerGroupServers --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --ServerIps.1 '192.168.xxx.xxx' --MaxResults 20 --Skip 1 --ServerGroupId 'sgp-atstuj3rtoptyui0000' --ServerIds.1 'i-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --method POST --force
